items.en: Iran states no movement in Hormuz without its permission, following reported tanker attacks.

items.en: Turkish foreign minister meets the new Hamas Political Bureau chief.

items.en: Egypt denies drone attack after a fire at Damietta Port.
items.he: מצרים מכחישה מתקפת מזל"ט לאחר שריפה בנמל דמייטה.

items.en: Trump states US will hit Iran hard after attack on Jordan bases.
